# lean-constellation target: `rootedNonroot_inverse_sigma_quadratic_collapsed_of_child_admissible`

Let `V` be a finite type with decidable equality, let `G` be a simple graph on `V` with decidable
adjacency, let `hG : G.IsTree`, let `w : V → ℤ`, and let `ρ : V`. Put

`R := {v : V // v ≠ ρ}`, `I := {c : V // c ∈ rootedChildren G hG ρ ρ}`, `C c := rootedChildComponent
G ρ c.1`, and the dependent Sigma index `S := Σ c : I, C c`.

Introduce the established shared dependent local representation binders for every `c : I`:

`letI (c : I) : Fintype (C c) := Fintype.ofFinite (C c)`,

and `letI (c : I) : DecidableRel (C c).toSimpleGraph.Adj` given by the established deleted-edge
adjacency convention for `G.deleteEdges {s(ρ, c.1)}`. These are representation binders, not
hypotheses.

Assume exactly

`∀ c : I, IsAdmissibleRootedTree (C c).toSimpleGraph (fun x => w (x : V)) (rootedChildRoot G ρ
c.1)`.

No ambient hypothesis `IsAdmissibleRootedTree G w ρ` is assumed. Let

`D := (rootedGram G w).submatrix Subtype.val Subtype.val`

and let `e := rootedChildComponentsEquivNonroot G hG ρ : S ≃ R`. Then the already-reindexed,
Sigma-indexed rational quadratic is exactly the canonical sum of child capacity summands:

`∑ p : S, ∑ q : S, rootedGram G w ρ ((e p : R) : V) * (Matrix.reindex e e D⁻¹) p q * rootedGram G w
((e q : R) : V) ρ = ∑ c in Finset.univ, rootedChildCapacitySummand G hG w ρ c`.

Thus the statement retains the exact canonical Sigma vertices, the root-row and root-column
coefficients at their `e`-images, and the reindexed nonroot inverse entry. It neither includes nor
normalizes the ambient `R`-indexed double sum, and retains the child-summand representation and
conclusion direction unchanged.

theorem rootedNonroot_inverse_sigma_quadratic_collapsed_of_child_admissible {V : Type*}
    [Fintype V] [DecidableEq V] (G : SimpleGraph V) [DecidableRel G.Adj] (hG : G.IsTree)
    (w : V → ℤ) (ρ : V) :
    let R := {v : V // v ≠ ρ}
    let I := {c : V // c ∈ rootedChildren G hG ρ ρ}
    let C : I → Type _ := fun c => rootedChildComponent G ρ c.1
    let S := (c : I) × C c
    letI : Fintype R := Fintype.ofFinite R
    letI : Fintype I := Fintype.ofFinite I
    letI : ∀ c : I, Fintype (C c) := fun c => Fintype.ofFinite _
    letI : ∀ c : I,
        DecidableRel (rootedChildComponent G ρ c.1).toSimpleGraph.Adj := fun c => by
      intro x y
      change Decidable ((G.deleteEdges {s(ρ, c.1)}).Adj (x : V) (y : V))
      infer_instance
    let D : Matrix R R ℚ := (rootedGram G w).submatrix Subtype.val Subtype.val
    let e := rootedChildComponentsEquivNonroot G hG ρ
    (∀ c : I, IsAdmissibleRootedTree (rootedChildComponent G ρ c.1).toSimpleGraph
      (fun x => w (x : V)) (rootedChildRoot G ρ c.1)) →
      ∑ p : S, ∑ q : S,
        rootedGram G w ρ ((e p : R) : V) *
          (Matrix.reindex e.symm e.symm D⁻¹) p q * rootedGram G w ((e q : R) : V) ρ =
        ∑ c ∈ Finset.univ, rootedChildCapacitySummand G hG w ρ c := by
  sorry
